bp_volunteer.text: This is Colossus, or rather a working rebuild of one, finished here in 2007 by volunteers led by Tony Sale. The originals were mostly broken up after the war, and the drawings burnt.
Tommy Flowers was a Post Office engineer. People told him his valves would never last. He left them switched on all the time, and they did.
Have a proper look at it. It's warm, it hums, and it smells faintly of hot dust and history.
